column1: # Debian packages the Dockerfile's apt-get layer installed (poppler-utils tesseract-ocr ca-certificates make, --no-install-recommends),
# as apt printed them in the image build of CI run 38197201361 (job make-run, 2026-10-12, linux/amd64): 62 new, 1 upgraded.
# Since R20 the base is python:3.11.17-slim-bookworm (Debian 12.15), which already holds the upgraded package
# (ca-certificates 20250419~deb12u1); tools/sbom.py image lists such a package once, as base. The layer now also runs
# apt-get upgrade (Debian security updates at build time); CI job image-scan scans the built image.
# source/source_version from the Debian bookworm Packages indexes; licence: an SPDX expression for the components
# Gegenprobe runs or loads (checked in debian/copyright), else the License: short names of the package's machine-readable
# debian/copyright (metadata.ftp-master.debian.org), else empty (free-text or not retrieved: the image's
# /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright holds it). Apt versions are not pinned (Dockerfile): a rebuild on another day can get newer security updates.
